name: WorkBuddy Switch Next — N cap with ear openings
prompt: Precise edit of the provided WorkBuddy Switch Next cat wearing a blue N baseball cap. User specifically requests TWO EAR HOLES IN THE CAP. Keep the same original green cat, face, eye and mouth positions, cheek pixel marks, curled tail, blue right-ear marking, ivory background, crop, colors, soft matte finish, and white capital N on the cap. Change only the cap construction and its interaction with the ears. The existing cap is perched between the ears, with the ears outside its sides: FIX this. Widen the blue cap's side panels so the cap sits over and wraps around BOTH ear bases, extending behind and outward around the lower portion of each ear. Cut one fitted oval/almond-shaped ear opening in EACH upper side panel. The green left ear and green/blue right ear must visibly EMERGE THROUGH these two holes. Essential visual proof: at each ear root, show a narrow curved cobalt-blue fabric rim in FRONT of the ear base and blue cap material continuing BEHIND it; the ear occludes the rear edge of the hole while the front rim occludes the ear's lower root. Add a small dark soft contact shadow inside each hole and restrained stitched edging following the opening. This must clearly look like ears passing through fitted holes, not ears pasted onto or next to a hat, and not two separate blue rings. Keep the original ears' approximate positions and shapes, with tips intact and recognizable, but allow the cap fabric to obscure their lower roots. Lower and fit the cap naturally to the cat's forehead. Keep the visor neat, short, and in the same coherent frontal perspective as the cap front panel and centered white N. No added ears, no goggles, no headphones, no extra accessories, no text other than the single white N. No change to the cat's face or body. One finished icon, same framing, no mockup.
integration: Ear-opening refinement preview; application and installer icons unchanged.
